verdict.rationale: Codegen exposes a Python SDK and REST API for creating/running agents, pulling logs/traces, and triggering agents from CI/CD (codegen-docs-11,15,16,17,27), giving strong parity for core agent-execution workflows. However, many UI-configurable capabilities—agent behavior/permission settings, integration setup (Slack, Linear, Jira, MCP servers), org/repo management—appear only documented as UI/CLI actions with no corresponding API endpoints, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (codegen-probe-2), suggesting the API surface is narrower than the full UI feature set. Missing for 10: API endpoints for settings/permissions management, integration configuration via API, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec confirming full coverage.
